_comment: Daily ALERT thresholds for check-provider-spend.js — owner-approved 2026-07-30 (Scraping Cost System v2, Option A). These are alarm lines, NOT enforcement: enforcement stays in the env-var caps (BROWSERBASE_MAX_SESSIONS_PER_DAY etc). Changing a number here changes when the digest yells, nothing else. BRO-2226 (2026-08-20): brightdataDailyUsd left AT 2.5 on purpose — investigated the 17/17-days-over alarm and found a real, fixable overspend (validate-show-venue.js's Tier-2 verifier was re-validating all ~40 provisional shows against Playbill on every single missing-show card attempt instead of just the added show, per data/audit/scraper-spend-ledger.jsonl the #1-2 BD caller every day; fixed to target --show=<addedId>), NOT a stale line — check-provider-spend.js's own decisionPrompt says raising this is an owner call, not a dispatched-session one, and the fix alone doesn't close the gap (BD volume is still several thousand req/day across many legitimate callers: opening-night-poller.js, audit-show-review-gap.js, gather-reviews.js). The alarm firing daily is correctly reporting real, uncapped overspend — leave it firing until either the owner raises the line or the other top callers get their own targeting fixes. Do not silently 3x this number to make the alarm stop.
